title: 第23章 收服福布斯族第24章 猪人部落
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
“我们走吧！”
孙云见差不多了，准备带着大家离去。
至于，狐人的效忠，孙云还真不在意，毕竟这些都是伤员和老幼，带着只是累赘。至于帮助她们，也只是顺手的事，就当做好事了。
“恩人，请留步。恩人，我们会信守承诺追随大人的。”
小孤女拦住孙云，认真的说道。
接着又漠然道！:“我们福布斯火狐一族是信守承诺的！”
“不需要，一群老弱病残，对于我们没有任何用！”
孙云漠然的摆摆手，头也不回的走过狐人。
“这……”
小女狐一楞，本来还有点不情愿的自己，现在感觉被嫌弃了。是啊，她们这群老弱病残，只会为别人带来负担，又有什么高傲的资本？
本来就不善战斗的她们，经过这次的消耗，已经没有几个年轻力壮的狐人了。壮年狐人几乎都战死了，恐怕别人一走，在这种恶劣的环境下，自己族人也存活不了多久了。
自己孤傲的表现，只会让人家觉得可笑！
“大人，我们还有二十个族人在外面，都是壮年狐人。虽然，我们狐人近战不强，但我们火狐一族人天生擅长火系魔法，对于远战还是有点作用的。请大人收留我们吧，我们也不是一无是处的，更擅长出谋划策，收留我们吧。”
狐人不愧为狡猾的种族，小狐女推销出了狐人的优势。
“你们为什么不投靠其他强大的种族？”
孙云疑惑的问道！
孙云这段时间，确实也在为融入兽人族的事情，一直在惆怅。而此时出现的狐人，确实是一个突破口，也不是不可以收她们。
有了这些狐人，就可以为自己的小队做掩护，还多了一些向导，总体来说还是值得的。但是，狐狸的狡猾，让孙云不得不提防。毕竟，孙云对其它种族并不熟悉，收留他们不知道是福还是祸。
“大人，我们狐人因不善于战斗，生的又俊美，所以在其他族群只能沦落下人或小妾的下场。我们的族人，不甘受屈辱，所以才沦落至此。我们族人虽然天生狡猾，但也是信守承诺之人，希望大人能收留我们。小狐观大人不像恶人，只求大人善待我们族人，小狐愿终生为奴。”小狐女忧伤的说道。
显然，虽然这小女狐人年龄不大，但还是看出了孙云的顾及。她之所以愿意追随孙云，也是看孙云等人看她们的眼神，没有其它种族那种色相。

当然了，她不知道，孙云这些人，全都是蚂蚁进化的，只是审美观不同罢了！至于孙云，骨子里还是喜欢正常人，对兽人暂时还接受不了！
“小姐？……大人，老奴愿意代替小姐侍奉大人。”
老狐人见小狐女可怜的样子，不忍的说道。
“算了，我不需要奴仆，只要你们真心追随就好！这是兽肉，对恢复有点作用，给大家分下去吧！”
孙云说着，递过去一些烤熟的肉食！
对于药物，孙云还真没有，大家已经习惯了用兽肉和魔兽晶核恢复。孙云的蚁军，只是一些强大的蚂蚁，终究智慧达不到生产药物的层次。
content_en:
"Let's go!"
Seeing that it was almost done, Sun Yun was ready to take everyone away.
As for the fox man's allegiance, Sun Yun really didn't care. After all, these were the wounded, old and young, and they were just a burden. As for helping them, it's just a casual thing, just treat it as a good deed.
"Benefactor, please stay. Benefactor, we will keep our promise and follow you."
The little orphan girl stopped Sun Yun and said seriously.
Then he said indifferently! : “We, the Forbes Firefox family, keep our promises!”
"No need, a group of old, weak, sick and disabled people are of no use to us!"
Sun Yun waved his hand indifferently and walked past the fox man without looking back.
"This..."
The little female fox was stunned. She was a little reluctant at first, but now she felt abandoned. Yes, they, the old, weak, sick and disabled, will only bring burdens to others, so what do they have to be proud of?
They were not good at fighting in the first place, but after this time of attrition, there were not many young and strong fox-men left. Almost all the fox people in their prime died in the battle. I am afraid that once others leave, my own people will not survive for long in this harsh environment.
My arrogant behavior will only make others feel ridiculous!
"Sir, we still have twenty tribesmen outside, all of whom are in their prime. Although we fox tribesmen are not strong in close combat, we fire fox tribe members are naturally good at fire magic, which is still useful for long-distance combat. Please take us in, sir. We are not useless. We are better at making suggestions. Take us in."
The fox people are worthy of being a cunning race, and the little fox girl promoted the advantages of the fox people.
"Why don't you join other powerful races?"
Sun Yun asked doubtfully!
Sun Yun has indeed been melancholy about integrating into the orc tribe during this period of time. The fox people who appeared at this time were indeed a breakthrough, and it was not impossible to accept them.
With these foxmen, you can provide cover for your team and have some additional guides. Overall, it's worth it. However, the cunning of the fox forced Sun Yun to be wary. After all, Sun Yun was not familiar with other races, so it was unclear whether taking them in would be a blessing or a curse.
"Sir, we fox people are not good at fighting and are beautiful, so we can only end up as servants or concubines in other ethnic groups. Our people are not willing to be humiliated, so we have fallen like this. Although our people are cunning by nature, we are also people who keep their promises. I hope you can take us in. The little fox does not look like evil people, but only asks you to treat our tribe well. The little fox is willing to be a slave for life." The little fox girl said sadly.
Obviously, although this little female fox was not old, she could still see Sun Yun's concern. The reason why she is willing to follow Sun Yun is because the way Sun Yun and others look at them is not as lustful as other races.
Of course, she didn't know that people like Sun Yun were all evolved from ants, but they just had different aesthetics! As for Sun Yun, he still likes normal people in his heart and cannot accept orcs yet!
"Miss?...My lord, this old slave is willing to serve your lord in place of the lady."
Seeing the pitiful look of the little fox girl, the old fox man said unbearably.
"Forget it, I don't need slaves, as long as you follow me sincerely! This is animal meat, it has some effect on recovery, share it with everyone!"
Sun Yun said, handing over some roasted meat!
As for medicine, Sun Yun really didn't have any. Everyone was already used to using animal meat and Warcraft crystal nuclei to recover. Sun Yun's ant army is just a few powerful ants. After all, their intelligence cannot reach the level of producing drugs.
